function.description: Requeue a BLOCKED goal with a rationale (§5.3 stewardship; resets its retry budget). On an owner turn it also lifts a PAUSED goal (the same rule as the owner's /goal retry).
function.name: goal_unblock

goal_id.description: The blocked goal id (or a paused one, on an owner turn).

rationale.description: Why it can proceed now (what changed).
